corrections: Use the seated foot as the size and material authority. Standing shoes have a thicker cream upper and shorter front-to-back length, with a rounded blunt toe, nearly flat top and flat sole. Cream and black meet flush as one solid, without a stacked cap or inflated black pad.

Rear standing views expose an upright heel wall with a nearly flat top edge and softly rounded rectangular corners, rather than duplicating the domed front toe. The ankle enters the rear/top of the same shoe; the forward toe is hidden in depth.
Standing front and rear black faces have no vertical seam. Only the midpoint of the black side band has one narrow seam; preserve the single-seam seated front foot and original seated side foot.
Seated rear has no visible feet or cream foot slivers. Preserve the two black leg housings and the outward-facing amber leg lights shown in the user-supplied rear crop.

Each black leg carries matching amber circular lights on both outer and inner side faces, as in the canonical master. Restore medial rings at the same height as lateral lights in standing front/rear; perspective narrows them to ellipses. Keep occluded medial faces hidden in side profile and never duplicate disks on one face.

Standing views, including their inner and outer leg lights, remain pixel-identical to the current baseline. Seated arms and rear foot visibility are revised; runtime sources and animation frames are unchanged.

Both shoulders retain the same compact rounded, tapered joint housing shown in standing front/side/rear views. The lamp is attached to the movable housing: it faces outward at rest and rotates upward on the raised anatomical right arm. Show the upward lamp on the upper curved surface consistently across seated views, with head occlusion respected; never substitute a bracelet-shaped barrel or a camera-facing lamp disk.

pose_selection.locomotion: Use standing reference to expose limb attachments; add action-specific key poses before generating a cycle.

animation_contract.scale: Choose one anatomical scale from the canonical head width. Reuse it for a whole clip; never fit each frame independently to its nontransparent bounds.
animation_contract.anchors: Keep a fixed root and ground plane; represent jumping and travel as intentional root offsets. Preserve crop offsets when exporting trimmed frames.

review_tolerances.status: initial review thresholds, not anatomical truth

animation_contract.rendering: Use one renderer-specific transform per clip/pose, not per-frame auto-centering. Do not impose identical whole-body heights on seated and standing poses.
animation_contract.validation: Review actual-size playback, contact points, loop seam and transitions into/out of seated idle; static references alone do not validate motion.
